description: This file defines the implementation of the DateCalculatorViewModel class, which manages date calculations, difference formatting, and UI data binding for a date calculator application. It includes methods for date difference computation, date addition/subtraction, and localization support.

classes.name: DateCalculatorViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class responsible for managing date calculations, formatting, and data binding for a date calculator UI.

methods.name: DateCalculatorViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the date calculator view model, setting up default values, localization, and date formats.

methods.name: OnPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles property change notifications to update dependent data or trigger recalculations.

methods.name: OnInputsChanged
methods.description: Performs date difference calculations or date addition/subtraction based on current mode and inputs.

methods.name: UpdateDisplayResult
methods.description: Updates the display strings for date difference or resulting date based on current calculation mode.

methods.name: UpdateStrDateDiffResultAutomationName
methods.description: Updates the automation name string for date difference results for accessibility.

methods.name: UpdateStrDateResultAutomationName
methods.description: Updates the automation name string for the resulting date for accessibility.

methods.name: InitializeDateOutputFormats
methods.description: Initializes date formatting objects for display and difference calculations based on calendar identifier.

methods.name: GetDateDiffString
methods.description: Generates a localized string describing the difference between two dates in years, months, weeks, and days.

methods.name: GetDateDiffStringInDays
methods.description: Generates a localized string describing the difference in days.

methods.name: OnCopyCommand
methods.description: Copies the current result (difference or date) to the clipboard.

methods.name: ClipTime
methods.description: Adjusts a DateTime object to 12AM of the same day, optionally using local time.
